description: This source file defines a utility for requesting and resolving the current location using CoreLocation. It includes a public enum `LocationCurrentRequest` that provides methods to resolve location with caching and timeout support, and to convert custom accuracy levels to `CLLocationAccuracy` values.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the current location, utilizing cached data if available and valid, otherwise requesting a new location within a specified timeout.

methods.name: accuracyValue
methods.description: Converts a custom `OpenClawLocationAccuracy` enum case to corresponding `CLLocationAccuracy` value.
